final_cache_policy: WebView manages its cache. App size observation is read-only, 1 GiB is advisory, and only explicit manual clearing invokes clearCache.
notes: Earlier manual-clear device evidence predates the final user-directed manual-only policy and is not final-package acceptance.
Final device cache retention checks never requested clearing and did not fill the phone with 1 GiB of test data.
Development failures are retained, including input shell timing overhead and background debugger freezing.
Intermediate candidate APKs and screenshots remain in the ignored local private directory.
